When is bulk trash picked up in Cedar Be: Bulk trash is picked up on the first Saturday of each month in Cedar Bend. Residents need to call Village Hall by the Wednesday before the pickup date to get on the list. The first three items are free, and each additional item costs $25.
How do I get rid of an old couch in Elm: Residents of Elm Ridge can take their old couch to the Larkspur County transfer station on Route 9, which is open Tuesday to Saturday from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. The fee is $15 per car or pickup load. They need to bring proof that they live in Elm Ridge.
What is the fine for parking on the stre: The fine for parking on the street overnight in Fox Run in winter is $50.
How much is a residential parking permit: A residential parking permit in Stone Mill costs $30 a year.
How much is a license for a dog that has: A license for a dog that is not spayed or neutered costs $20.
How much will the new playground at Mill: The new playground at Miller Park will cost $84,000.
Who ran the Alder Creek council meeting: Council President Diego Ramirez presided over the Alder Creek council meeting in September.
Do older residents get a discount on wat: Yes, residents aged 65 or older can get a 15% discount on their water bill in Heron Point.
How long can I borrow a book from the Ju: You can borrow a book from the Juniper Flats library for three weeks and renew it twice, unless someone else has requested it.
When is open burning allowed in Willow B: Open burning is allowed from October 1 to April 30, between sunrise and sunset in Willow Bend.
When is the second half of property tax: The second half of property tax is due on September 30.
How did the Birch Hollow Select Board vo: The Birch Hollow Select Board voted 3 to 2 to hire a second member for the road crew, with members Henning and Oakley voting against it.
What time does the Quarry Hill pool open: The Quarry Hill Community Pool opens from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. every day from Memorial Day to Labor Day.
Where can I recycle an old TV?: The transfer station in Larkspur County can take old electronics, such as televisions and computers, for free on the second Saturday of each month.
Can I burn my garbage?: No, burning trash, plastic, or building materials is against the law at any time of year in Willow Bend.
How much is a family season pass for the: A family season pass for the Stone Mill pool costs $60.
